description: Proofer incident codes (señala; el editor decide) for agent memory.

rules.title: Combining Unicode diacritics
rules.guidance: Prefer precomposed characters or HSMS ASCII diacritic notation over combining marks (e.g. c', n~).

rules.title: Provisional HTR markers
rules.guidance: Replace Transkribus fullwidth ＜＞ / ⊂⊃ with <…> and grave ` superscript marks with <<…>> (or run convert_htr_to_hsms).

rules.title: AD/GL payload format
rules.guidance: {AD.} / {GL.} with text must use a space then [^…], e.g. {AD. [^added]}.

rules.title: Invisible whitespace
rules.guidance: Do not emit NBSP, TAB, or ZWSP — use ordinary ASCII spaces only.

rules.title: Leading/trailing spaces
rules.guidance: Do not begin or end a physical line with an ASCII space.

rules.title: Consecutive spaces
rules.guidance: Avoid two or more consecutive ASCII spaces on the same line (except the single space after {INn.}).

rules.title: Overlong line
rules.guidance: Keep lines under ~150 characters; break at natural word boundaries.

rules.title: Ellipsis outside brackets
rules.guidance: Ellipsis ... may appear only inside brackets [...].

rules.title: Adjacent brace tags
rules.guidance: When } and { meet on the same line, put an intervening ASCII space.

rules.title: Hyphen before closing brace
rules.guidance: Do not place a hyphen immediately before }.

rules.title: Lowercase HSMS tags
rules.guidance: Write structural tags in uppercase ({RUB. not {rub.).

rules.title: Too many question marks
rules.guidance: Illegibility is ?? or ??? only — never four or more consecutive ?.

rules.title: Calderón spacing
rules.guidance: Calderón marks (%, %2, %3) need a space before and after except at line edges.

rules.title: Double calderón
rules.guidance: Avoid two consecutive calderones unless clearly intentional in the source.

rules.title: Invalid <…> / <<…>>
rules.guidance: Abbreviation/superscript delimiters must be non-empty, same-line, without internal spaces.

rules.title: Unclosed angle delimiters
rules.guidance: <…> and <<…>> must open and close on the same physical line.

rules.title: Space after insert/delete openers
rules.guidance: After [^, (^, or [* the text must follow immediately with no space.

rules.title: Hand marker spacing
rules.guidance: Non-original hand markers use [^2#text] with no space between digit and #.

rules.title: Deletion+insertion gap
rules.guidance: Substitutions (x)[y] must not have a space between ) and [.

rules.title: Empty deletion
rules.guidance: Empty parentheses for a deleted space should be ( ).

rules.title: Unbalanced brackets on a line
rules.guidance: Balance [ and ] on each physical line whenever possible.

rules.title: Unbalanced parentheses on a line
rules.guidance: Balance ( and ) on each physical line whenever possible.

rules.title: CW/SG not same-line closed
rules.guidance: {CW. …} and {SG. …} must include text and close with } on the same line.

rules.title: Unclosed RMK
rules.guidance: {RMK: must close with } on the same physical line.

rules.title: RMK missing final period
rules.guidance: {RMK: should end with a period immediately before }.

rules.title: RMK delimiter
rules.guidance: {RMK must use : as its delimiter.

rules.title: AD/GL hand insertions
rules.guidance: {AD. / {GL. hand insertions should use [^… immediately after the tag text.

rules.title: Equals vector outside MIN/DIAG
rules.guidance: = as a vector marker is only allowed inside {MIN. / {DIAG. tags.

rules.title: Unrecognized HSMS tag
rules.guidance: Use only catalogued mnemonics (CB, HD, RUB, GL, CW, SG, IN, LAT, …).

rules.title: Multiple blank lines
rules.guidance: Avoid more than one consecutive blank line between blocks.

rules.title: Unresolved +} continuation
rules.guidance: If a tag ends with +}, a later matching tag must resume the text.

rules.title: Witness filename sigla
rules.guidance: Witness filenames should be TEXT.SIGLA.txt (client-side naming; agent usually ignores).
